doc: Tangent velocity of the default zonal flow (no vortices) at 622 float64 unit directions: both poles (the velocity is exactly 0 there: cross(z, p) = 0), the equator at nine longitudes with both antimeridian columns, a pair straddling it, mid-latitudes. Float64: a few products and sums of the float64 rate: rtol 1e-9, atol 1e-12. Conventions of cloudgen.sphere read here: lonlat_to_dir(lon, lat) = (cos lat cos lon, cos lat sin lon, sin lat) with float64 numpy cos and sin (right-handed, z north, longitude grows east; a vortex center is that direction); normalize(v) = v / |v| (plain division, no epsilon: a zero vector gives NaN).
